en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph depicting the construction or testing of a steel bridge. Several men, some in overcoats and hats, stand near or upon the bridge, along with a steamroller or early road construction vehicle. There is a dog visible to the left, and the background includes some buildings and a mountainous landscape. On the right side of the postcard, there is text written in Cyrillic script.
